title: CERN_GAPS_FORWARD_BLIND_PREDICTIONS
qualitative_difference_from_CR091_CR096: CR091..CR096 compared 09a predictions against already-public CERN values; CR098 commits SAM predictions BEFORE CERN publishes a matching measurement

forward_blind_principle.rule_1: Every prediction in the registry is sha256-locked at runner time. The hash + utc timestamp is the cryptographic record that SAM committed BEFORE any CERN publication on the matching observable.
forward_blind_principle.rule_2: Predictions are not modified after the registry sha256 sibling is written. Period.
forward_blind_principle.rule_3: When CERN publishes a measurement that matches a registered gap, an APPEAL_NEW_CERN_MEASUREMENT row is APPENDED. The original prediction row is never overwritten.
forward_blind_principle.rule_4: A CERN measurement that contradicts a registered prediction is recorded as such on the appeal row, with the residual, the citation, and the experiment. SAM does NOT retrofit the prediction.
forward_blind_principle.rule_5: A CERN measurement that confirms a registered prediction is recorded as such on the appeal row with the same fields. SAM does NOT take credit beyond what the residual shows.

prediction_status_classes.FORWARD_BLIND_UNMEASURED: no current CERN measurement; no active CERN search known
prediction_status_classes.FORWARD_BLIND_SEARCH_ACTIVE: a CERN experiment has an ongoing search program in this mass / charge / channel range
prediction_status_classes.FORWARD_BLIND_NO_SEARCH_DEFINED: the prediction sits in a mass / energy band CERN does not currently cover (e.g., sub-eV scalars, ultra-light dark sector)
prediction_status_classes.FORBIDDEN_PARTITION_NEGATIVE_PREDICTION: SAM predicts NO particle at this structural shape; if CERN observes one matching the shape, SAM is broken (SAM-X-012 anchor)

open_debts_declared_at_CR098: Per-row suggested_CERN_search_program is best-fit; curator should verify each program's coverage band before promoting registry to VERIFIED_BY_CURATOR.
Upstream source sha256 fields PENDING; curator promotes to VERIFIED when source files are independently re-hashed.
Future CERN publications will be appended via APPEAL_NEW_CERN_MEASUREMENT rows; the original registry rows remain immutable.
Blindness protocol sha256 written by runner; the broader seal sha256 sibling pending curator sign-off.
